textwithimage.text:
Intel® Core™ (6th Generation) 6000E series ("Skylake-H")

The TQ Module TQMx60EB, a COM Express® Basic Type 6 module powered by Intel's 6th Generation Core™ processors (Skylake-H), offers exceptional computing and graphics capabilities. With support for Dual-Channel DDR4-2133, high-bandwidth PCIe, 4x SATA (6 Gb/s), and 4x USB 3.0, it delivers top-tier system performance, making it ideal for demanding applications in the medical, gaming, and industrial sectors.

This module is versatile, supporting 6th Generation Intel Core™ i7/i5/i3 and Intel Xeon® E3-15xx v5 processors, offering a range of options to suit your specific needs. The integrated Intel® graphics controller provides support for up to three independent display outputs at 4K resolution, offering excellent 3D and rendering performance. With features like Intel® Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and Enhanced Intel® SpeedStep Technology, it optimizes power and performance for a superior user experience with efficient power consumption.

Designed for reliability, the TQMx60EB comes with ECC memory protection and boasts 24/7 certification. Its large bandwidth with up to 24 PCIe lanes and the flexibility of Intel® Core™ processors make it a powerhouse for FPGA engineers seeking high-performance solutions for their projects. Whether you're in medical, gaming, or industrial fields, the TQMx60EB offers a robust and dependable computing solution for your needs.

text.text:
Features

  • PCIe x16 PEG Port: High-speed PCIe expansion for enhanced connectivity.

  • ECC Memory Support: Error-correcting memory for data integrity.

  • Multiple Display Outputs: Support for up to three independent displays at 4K resolution.

  • Versatile Processor Options: Compatibility with 6th Generation Intel® Core™ i7/i5/i3 and Intel® Xeon® E3-15xx v5 processors.

  • Reliable 24/7 Certification: Built for uninterrupted performance in critical applications.

table.text:
CPU
  • Intel® Xeon® E3-1500 v5 series (Skylake-H)
  • Xeon E3-1505M v5 (4x 2.8/3.7 GHz, 8 MB, GT2, 45/35 W)
  • Xeon E3-1505L v5 (4x 2.0/2.8 GHz, 8 MB, GT2, 25 W)
  • Intel® Core™ 6000E series (Skylake-H)
  • Core i7-6822EQ (4x 2.0/2.8 GHz, 8 MB, GT2, 25 W)
  • Core i7-6820EQ (4x 2.8/3.5 GHz, 8 MB, GT2, 45/35 W)
  • Core i5-6440EQ (4x 2.7/3.4 GHz, 6 MB, GT2, 45/35 W)
  • Core i5-6442EQ (4x 1.9/2.7 GHz, 6 MB, GT2, 25 W)
  • Core i3-6100E (2x 2.7 GHz, 3 MB, GT2, 35 W)
  • Core i3-6102E (2x 1.9 GHz, 3 MB, GT2, 25 W)
Memory
  • DDR4 = 32GB
  • EEPROM - 32kbit
Graphics
  • 3x Digital Display Interface/DP++ with up to 4K @ 60 Hz for DP 1.2a/HDMI 1.4 with multi stream transport (MST)
  • LVDS Interface (18/24-bit, Single/Dual Channel) (optional eDP 1.3 with 4 lanes instead of LVDS)
  • Intel® Quick Sync Video and Wireless Display support
Communications Interfaces
  • Ethernet - 1x Gbit Ethernet
  • USB - 4x USB 3.0 | 8x USB 2.0
  • Serial Ports - 2x Serial Port
Other Interfaces
  • PCIe - 1x PEG Port with PCIe x16 Gen 3 | 8x PCIe Gen 3
  • LPC - LPC bus
  • I2C
  • SMBus
  • SPI - SPI (for external UEFI BIOS flash)
  • Audio - Intel HD Audio
  • GPIO - 8x GPIO through TQ-flexiCFG
  • SATA = 4x STAT Gen 3
General
  • Dimensions - 125mm x 95mm
  • Plug-in System - COM Express Compact, Type 6
  • Temperature range - Standard temperature: 0°C…+60°C (HE versions)
  • Power supply - 8.5 ... 20 V, 5 V Standby (optional), 3 V Battery for RTC
  • Power consumption - Power: typ. 25-30 W/max. 60 W (Green ECO-Off: < 0.1 W)
